article.title: Bank implicated in Paraguayan financial crisis sponsored far-right Gala at Trump’s Mar-a-Lago
article.author: Editor
article.content: The Paraguayan Ueno Bank, whose insolvency-related intervention triggered a financial and political crisis that led President Santiago Peña to resign, was one of the main sponsors of a gala for conservative organizations held last February at Mar-a-Lago, Donald Trump’s private residence in Florida, United States.
